result.title: Divergence-Routed On-Policy Distillation for Language Models
result.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers knowledge from a teacher model to a student along student-generated trajectories, typically by minimizing the reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) divergence. However, RKL can provide weak corrective signals for teacher-supported tokens to which the student assigns very low probability. This raises two questions: which positions are most consequential for the behavioral gap between the student and teacher, and what additional supervision is needed at these positions? Through cross-sampling, we find that divergence-based routing more effectively pinpoints positions contributing to the teacher-student performance gap than entropy-based routing. Further analysis reveals teacher-mode under-coverage at high Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence positions, where standard OPD increases the large teacher-student probability gaps. Motivated by these findings, we propose Divergence-Routed On-Policy Distillation (DrOPD). DrOPD retains RKL supervision at all positions and selectively adds forward Kullback-Leibler (FKL) divergence supervision at positions with high JS divergence. Experiments across six math benchmarks show that DrOPD improves over standard OPD and entropy-based routing. DrOPD also reduces severe under-coverage cases by 37.9 percent relative to OPD, supporting targeted FKL as an effective complement to OPD.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 on-policy 蒸馏中 RKL 对教师支持但学生概率极低的 token 矫正信号偏弱的问题，发现按散度路由比按熵路由更能定位师生性能差距所在位置，并据此提出 DrOPD，在高 JS 散度位置保留 RKL 的同时额外加入 FKL 监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按分歧度定位高贡献位置并差异化施加监督」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 步骤的贡献分配、监督信号选择与证据位置筛选提供借鉴；但该工作限于纯文本蒸馏、无视觉状态或 latent 推理，迁移线索可供核查。
